rules.title: Cartwright Act: common pricing algorithm used in restraint of trade (AB 325)
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of the Cartwright Act.
rules.coverage_text: Any person who uses or distributes a common pricing algorithm, meaning any methodology, including a computer, software, or other technology, used by two or more persons, that uses competitor data to recommend, align, stabilize, set, or otherwise influence a price or commercial term. Distribution includes selling, licensing, providing access to, or otherwise making available by any means, including through a subscription or the sale of a service.
rules.exemptions: "Person" does not include the end consumer of a product or service.
rules.citation: Business and Professions Code Section 16729(a) (AB 325, Chapter 338)
rules.penalty: Violation of the Cartwright Act is punishable as a crime.
rules.quoted_span: (a) It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of this chapter.
rules.interaction_text: (c) Nothing in this section shall impair or limit the applicability of antitrust laws.

rules.title: Cartwright Act: coercion to adopt common pricing algorithm recommendations (AB 325)
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a price or commercial term recommended by the algorithm for the same or similar products or services in California.
rules.coverage_text: Any person who uses or distributes a common pricing algorithm, meaning any methodology, including a computer, software, or other technology, used by two or more persons, that uses competitor data to recommend, align, stabilize, set, or otherwise influence a price or commercial term (including level of service, availability, and output).
rules.exemptions: "Person" does not include the end consumer of a product or service.
rules.citation: Business and Professions Code Section 16729(b) (AB 325, Chapter 338)
rules.penalty: Violation of the Cartwright Act is punishable as a crime.
rules.quoted_span: (b) It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services in the jurisdiction of this state.
rules.interaction_text: (c) Nothing in this section shall impair or limit the applicability of antitrust laws.
